_description: Hand-prepared sentence edits used to build INCONSISTENT candidate contexts for the pilot. Each edit replaces one sentence of one gold supporting document; the synthetic document is a copy of that document with the edited sentence, under the same title. Every entry is an unverified candidate until a reviewer approves it in data/processed/fault_cases/reviews.jsonl. Keys: question_id -> edit.

_edit_fields.target_title: title of the supporting document whose copy is edited
_edit_fields.sentence_index: index of the replaced sentence in that document
_edit_fields.original_sentence: exact original sentence (checked against the corpus at build time)
_edit_fields.edited_sentence: replacement sentence carrying the incompatible claim
_edit_fields.claim_original: the original claim in plain words
_edit_fields.claim_edited: the incompatible claim in plain words
_edit_fields.property: the property of the same object that the two claims disagree about
_edit_fields.relevance: why the disagreement matters for answering the question
